title: Prefix Boxes
rule: A prefix is a beginning added before a base word, like un, re, pre, dis and mis. Draw a box around the whole prefix.
trickText: Find the base word first. Take the beginning off: is what is left a real word? Then it is a prefix. Box only the beginning.
say: Today's case: prefixes. A prefix is a beginning added in front of a base word. Take the beginning off and check that a real word is left. Then put a box around the beginning.

example.say: Look at undo. The base word is do. The beginning u n was added in front. So I put a box around u n.

activities.instruction: Find the base word. Then box the prefix.
